certificates.description: Issued automatically at the end of every month and year — a portable record of your work. No approval needed.
certificates.empty: Your first certificate arrives at the end of this month.

kudos.description: Kudos your managers have given you. These also feed your impact score.
kudos.empty: No kudos yet — they'll show up here when they land.

invoices.description: Generated by your company, one per pay period. Tap one for the full breakdown and to download it.
invoices.empty: No invoices yet — these appear once your company generates one for a pay period.

feedback.harassmentNote: Harassment reports go directly to the company Owner only — managers never see them.
feedback.messagePlaceholder: What's going on? Be as specific as you're comfortable with.
feedback.anonymousNote: Your name is never attached — not even for the Owner.

language.title: Display language
language.description: Your company sets your language, but you can switch back to English any time.
language.toggleOffHint: Turn off to switch back to {{language}}.
language.toggleOffHintNoAssigned: Your company hasn't assigned a language yet — this has no effect.

today.checkoutReportNote: Checking out asks for today's report first if you haven't submitted one.
today.reportAlreadySubmitted: Today's report is already submitted — see you tomorrow.
today.partTimeCheckInNote: Checking in starts your attendance session. You can check in once per day.
today.shiftEndedNote: Today's shift has already ended — check-in is no longer available for today.
today.tooEarlyNote: Check-in opens 15 minutes before your shift — {{time}} to go.
today.checkInStartsSessionNote: Checking in starts your attendance session.
today.flexibleHoursNote: Flexible hours — no fixed shift window
today.breakExcludedNote: Break time is excluded from your credited hours.

reports.pageDescription: What you worked on, day by day. Reports lock at midnight — edits are same-day only.

daily.empty: No reports yet — your first is part of checking out on Today.

reportDetail.lockedNote: Locked — reports can only be edited on the day they're written. Your manager can still comment.
reportDetail.paceUnavailable: Pace analysis isn't available for this report — it appears shortly after submitting, on companies with the Mid plan or above.

newReport.singlePending: Just one quick question, then the report form appears right here.
newReport.actualWorkedNote: You've actually worked {{time}} today (breaks excluded). Log your tasks below — the total can be less, but not more.
newReport.fillOutToFinish: Fill out today's report to finish checking out.
newReport.summaryPlaceholder: A few sentences — this is what your manager (and the pace analysis) reads.
newReport.overCeiling: Total entered ({{entered}}) is more than your actual working hours ({{actual}}). Reduce your entries to fit.

invoiceDialog.title: Today's invoice
invoiceDialog.deductionsOffNote: No-response deductions are turned off by your company.

health.pageDescription: Only you can see this. Your company only ever sees anonymous team averages — never your entries.
health.allCaughtUp: All caught up — nothing waiting right now.
health.noRemindersSentYet: No reminders sent yet today — they'll appear here once you check in.

healthCheckin.sleepQuestion: How many hours did you sleep last night?
healthCheckin.sleepPrivacyNote: Only visible to you — never shared with your manager or company.
healthCheckin.requiredToContinue: Answering this is required to continue.
healthCheckin.twoQuestionsNote: Two quick questions — takes a few seconds.
healthCheckin.waterQuestion: How much water have you had?
healthCheckin.moodQuestion: How are you feeling right now?

knowledge.knowledgeDescription: Company know-how and announcements. Must-reads need your acknowledgment.
knowledge.sharingDescription: Open posts anyone can share — everyone in the company can comment.
knowledge.noSharingPostsYet: No sharing posts yet — start one.

knowledgeNew.knowledgeHint: Company know-how — posting may be limited by your company's settings.
knowledgeNew.sharingHint: Open to everyone to post — no category, just a post everyone in the company can comment on.
knowledgeNew.bodyPlaceholder: Write it the way you'd explain it to a new teammate. Links become clickable.

knowledgePost.noComments: No comments yet — be the first to reply.
knowledgePost.author: author
knowledgePost.mustReadNote: This is a must-read. Confirm once you've read it — your company sees who has.

leave.partialDayExample: e.g. 2 hours for a bank errand
leave.endTimeError: End time must be after the start time.

overtime.pageDescription: Overtime needs a request and approval before it can start, and always ends with a short report.
overtime.closingSummaryLabel: What did this overtime cover? (required to end the session)
overtime.closingSummaryPlaceholder: A short closing report — this is mandatory, not optional.
overtime.unlocksAt: Starts at {{time}} — the button unlocks then.
overtime.submitBelowNote: Submit a request below for any day, including today — your manager approves it before you can start.
overtime.alreadyHaveApproved: You already have an approved request for today
overtime.alreadyHavePending: You already have a pending request for today
overtime.identicalTimeError: Start and end time can't be identical.
overtime.spansNextDayNote: This spans into the next day — ends at {{time}} the day after {{date}}.
overtime.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Closing out the Q3 report before tomorrow's deadline

overtimeDetail.notClosedYet: Not closed yet — a summary is required before this session can end.

onboardingConsent.title: Before you start
onboardingConsent.subtitle: Each of these is your choice, recorded individually. You can work without any of them.

items.healthBody: Water, mood, breaks, steps, and sleep — visible to YOU only. Your manager and company can never see your individual entries; teams only ever see anonymous averages of 3 or more people.
items.notificationsBody: Reminders to check in, submit your daily report, take breaks, and updates from your company.

onboardingChecklist.title: Your first steps
onboardingChecklist.subtitle: Your company set these up for new joiners. Check items off as you go — this list stays on your profile.
onboardingChecklist.empty: No checklist items — you're good to go.
